entities.name: Alonso de Idiáquez de Butrón y Múgica
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alonso de Idiáquez Butrón y Múgica was a Spanish nobleman, soldier and councillor. The first Duke of Ciudad Real, he served as the viceroy of Navarre and captain-general of Gipuzkoa from 1610 until his death.
